verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI supports persistent browser profiles with saved authentication/cookies, session management for multi-step crawling, and hook-based JS execution/browser control that could be used to click links or fill forms across a login flow. However, there is no explicit documented example of a login-wall click/fill workflow — missing for 10: a documented form-fill/click walkthrough, evidence of handling multi-page authenticated flows end-to-end, and independent confirmation it works against real login walls.
